description: DEEP cosmic combos that feel AMAZING to execute - easy to understand, hard to master, impossible to forget

WHAT_IS_A_YOGA.definition: A YOGA is a meta-combo that transcends normal skill combinations - it's when skills, timing, and cosmic forces align perfectly to create something legendary
WHAT_IS_A_YOGA.philosophy: Yogas aren't just combos - they're MOMENTS. When you pull off a Yoga, the game KNOWS and celebrates it

requirements.cosmic_timing: Must be cast during specific Nakshatra, Dasha, or planetary transit
requirements.positioning: Often requires specific house placement or structure geometry
requirements.resource_threshold: Must have sufficient KP, Bandwidth, or other resources

rewards.instant_feedback: Screen effect, epic sound, slow-motion moment
rewards.permanent_effects: Some Yogas leave lasting changes to the battlefield
rewards.achievement_tracking: Game tracks which Yogas you've executed
rewards.community_sharing: Yoga replays auto-upload to community highlights

deep_yet_easy: Requirements are simple to understand (e.g., 'Cast during Full Moon')
Execution is intuitive (drag skills to formation pattern)
Mastery comes from TIMING, not complexity
Visual feedback makes cosmic alignment obvious
amazing_feeling: Every Yoga has a unique screen effect when triggered
Cosmic alignment feels like 'the stars are with you'
Power spike is IMMEDIATE and OBVIOUS
Opponent sees it coming but can't stop it (creates tension)
strategic_depth: Telegraphing - opponent sees you building the Yoga
Counter-play window - they can disrupt if they're smart
Risk-reward - investing in Yoga setup makes you vulnerable
Meta-gaming - knowing when opponent has Yoga available

THE_5_FOUNDATIONAL_YOGAS.description: Each Yoga represents a fundamental strategic archetype

YOGA_01_BASTION_OF_ETERNITY.name: Bastion of Eternity
YOGA_01_BASTION_OF_ETERNITY.flavor_text: When Saturn blesses your foundation, nothing can move you. You become the immovable object, the eternal fortress, the mountain that outlasts civilizations.

skills_needed.effect: All shields in zone share damage equally
Structures cannot be destroyed or moved

cosmic_timing.duration: Lasts 8-12 turns depending on match length
cosmic_timing.check: Game UI shows 'SATURN DASHA ACTIVE' with planet icon

positioning.visualization: Skills form literal square when dragged into Crucible

resource_cost.note: Expensive but worth it - this wins games

EXECUTION.step_1: Wait for Saturn Dasha to begin (UI notification appears)
EXECUTION.step_2: Arrange 4 skills in 2×2 square formation in Crucible
EXECUTION.step_3: System detects Yoga pattern + cosmic timing alignment
EXECUTION.step_4: YOGA READY notification + golden glow on skills
EXECUTION.step_5: Drag complete Yoga to battlefield position
EXECUTION.step_6: BASTION OF ETERNITY screen effect triggers

immediate.structure_invulnerability: All 4 structures become immune to damage for 3 turns
immediate.zone_control: 5×5 area becomes 'Eternal Ground' - enemies slowed 50% inside

sustained.damage_reflect: 20% of incoming damage reflected to attacker

permanent.battlefield_scar: Even after structures fall, 'Eternal Ground' effect persists
permanent.achievement: First Yoga executed unlocks 'Cosmic Architect' title

SCREEN_EFFECT.visual: Saturn symbol glows above battlefield, stone walls rise from ground, golden forcefield shimmers
SCREEN_EFFECT.audio: Deep gong sound + ethereal chanting + stone grinding
SCREEN_EFFECT.camera: Slow-motion zoom on structures as they crystallize into eternity

prevention: Disrupt formation before Saturn Dasha ends
Resource drain to prevent 30 KP accumulation
Zone denial - occupy the 4th House so they can't cast there
response: Shield-breaking skills bypass invulnerability after 3 turns
Mobility skills to avoid 5×5 zone entirely
Wait it out - Bastion is defensive, doesn't win alone
COUNTER_PLAY.difficulty: Hard to counter once setup - prevention is key

MASTERY_TIPS.beginner: Just survive until Saturn Dasha, then setup and win
MASTERY_TIPS.intermediate: Bait enemy into committing resources, THEN drop Bastion
MASTERY_TIPS.advanced: Setup in 4th House for +50% duration, control 2/3 of map
MASTERY_TIPS.expert: Combine with Bandwidth generation for permanent KP engine
MASTERY_TIPS.note: This Yoga teaches defensive patience and cosmic timing

YOGA_02_CHAINS_OF_PROMETHEUS.name: Chains of Prometheus
YOGA_02_CHAINS_OF_PROMETHEUS.flavor_text: Steal fire from the gods and never give it back. Your resources become infinite, your actions unlimited. You are the engine that never stops.

skills_needed.effect: Each structure generates 1 new structure every 3 turns
Skills in this Yoga have 0 cooldown

positioning.visualization: Skills pulse in sequence showing the resource flow loop

resource_cost.note: VERY expensive to start, but pays back infinitely

EXECUTION.step_1: Build up 50 KP + 80 Bandwidth + 30 Ojas (hard part!)
EXECUTION.step_3: Arrange 5 skills in star formation in Crucible
EXECUTION.step_4: System detects PROMETHEUS YOGA + shows resource flow animation
EXECUTION.step_5: Cast during conjunction window (you have 2-turn window)
EXECUTION.step_6: CHAINS OF PROMETHEUS ignites - screen turns gold

immediate.infinite_engine_activation: The loop begins - resources start cascading

loop_mechanics.turn_2: Bandwidth converts to KP and Ojas
loop_mechanics.turn_4: More structures = more Bandwidth = LOOP ACCELERATES
loop_mechanics.scaling: Each cycle generates 20% more than the last
loop_mechanics.cap: Caps at 500% after 10 cycles (to prevent game break)

sustained.resource_overflow: You always have maximum resources available
sustained.zero_cooldowns: Skills in the loop never go on cooldown
sustained.unstoppable_scaling: Every turn you get stronger exponentially

win_condition.timing: If loop runs for 8 turns uninterrupted, you basically win
win_condition.counterplay_window: Enemy has 3-4 turns to disrupt or they lose

SCREEN_EFFECT.visual: Golden chains of light connect all 5 skills, spinning faster and faster, Bandwidth numbers flying everywhere
SCREEN_EFFECT.audio: Accelerating heartbeat + mechanical whirring + triumphant orchestra
SCREEN_EFFECT.camera: Zooms out to show entire loop structure, then back to your glowing avatar
SCREEN_EFFECT.duration: 5-second cinematic showing the first loop cycle

prevention: Resource denial - drain them before they hit thresholds
Deny Mercury-Jupiter timing - pressure them during conjunction windows
Make them choose: setup Prometheus or defend themselves
response: IMMEDIATE structure destruction - break the loop before it accelerates
Silence effects to disable skill casting
All-in aggression - kill them before loop pays off
Resource drain to starve the conversion matrix
COUNTER_PLAY.difficulty: EXTREMELY hard to counter once running - must prevent setup

MASTERY_TIPS.beginner: This Yoga is TOO HARD for beginners - try Bastion first
MASTERY_TIPS.intermediate: Practice resource management - hit thresholds consistently
MASTERY_TIPS.advanced: Bait enemy cooldowns, THEN setup during their weakness
MASTERY_TIPS.expert: Setup in 11th House for double generation = instant victory
MASTERY_TIPS.god_tier: Chain Prometheus into ANOTHER Yoga on turn 6 for 'Prometheus Unbound' achievement
MASTERY_TIPS.note: This is the hardest Yoga to execute but the most rewarding

YOGA_03_MIRROR_OF_THE_SOUL.name: Mirror of the Soul
YOGA_03_MIRROR_OF_THE_SOUL.flavor_text: Become your enemy. Learn their thoughts, mimic their power, reflect their attacks. The perfect counter is to become them, then surpass them.

skills_needed.effect: Your structures gain tags matching enemy's strongest skills
You can cast enemy's last skill at 80% power

cosmic_timing.required: Full Moon in opponent's birth Nakshatra
cosmic_timing.frequency: Once per match against each opponent
cosmic_timing.check: Game analyzes opponent's deck and shows 'SOUL MIRROR AVAILABLE' when timing is right
cosmic_timing.why_this_timing: Full Moon = revelation, opponent's Nakshatra = personal to them

positioning.visualization: Skills form mirror image of opponent's formation

resource_cost.note: Moderate cost, but timing requirement is the real challenge

EXECUTION.step_1: Observe enemy's strategy for first 5-7 turns
EXECUTION.step_2: Wait for Full Moon notification in opponent's Nakshatra
EXECUTION.step_3: Arrange 3 skills in triangle formation pointing at enemy
EXECUTION.step_4: MIRROR YOGA detected - UI shows ghostly copy of enemy
EXECUTION.step_5: Cast yoga - becomes reactive to opponent's actions
EXECUTION.step_6: MIRROR OF THE SOUL - screen splits showing you and enemy as reflections
EXECUTION.execution_time: Quick setup, but requires match-reading skill

immediate.property_copy: Your structures gain all enemy structure properties
immediate.skill_access: Gain temporary access to opponent's 3 most-used skills
immediate.damage_reflection: Next 3 enemy attacks hit themselves instead

duration.learning: You permanently learn opponent's strategy patterns

psychological.intimidation: Opponent realizes you know their gameplan
psychological.adaptation: You can now counter their future moves
psychological.mind_games: They have to completely change strategy or get countered

SCREEN_EFFECT.visual: Screen splits vertically - you on left, enemy on right, mirror line between showing energy exchange
SCREEN_EFFECT.audio: Glass chiming + whispered echo of enemy voice lines + ethereal mirror sounds
SCREEN_EFFECT.camera: Alternates between showing your reflection and enemy's surprised face

prevention: Play unpredictably to prevent pattern recognition
Force opponent to use resources before Full Moon timing
Switch strategies mid-match to invalidate their observation
response: STOP ATTACKING during mirror phase - reflection hurts you
Switch to healing/buffing - can't be reflected
Complete strategy pivot - use skills you haven't shown yet
COUNTER_PLAY.difficulty: Medium - skilled players can adapt, but requires quick thinking

MASTERY_TIPS.beginner: Easy to execute - just wait for Full Moon and copy enemy
MASTERY_TIPS.intermediate: Use Mirror as psychological warfare - make them doubt themselves
MASTERY_TIPS.advanced: Copy enemy's BEST combo, improve it with your own twist
MASTERY_TIPS.expert: Bait enemy into revealing their strategy, then Mirror + counter
MASTERY_TIPS.mind_game: Sometimes THREATEN Mirror without using it - they'll play scared
MASTERY_TIPS.note: This Yoga teaches match reading and adaptation

YOGA_04_PHOENIX_CRUCIBLE.name: Phoenix Crucible
YOGA_04_PHOENIX_CRUCIBLE.flavor_text: Burn everything to ashes, then rise stronger from the flames. Destruction is transformation. Death is evolution. You are the phoenix.

skills_needed.role: Destroys your own structures for resources
skills_needed.effect: Sacrifice structures → gain 3× their value in resources
New structures have +100% stats after sacrifice
If you would lose, revive at 50% instead (once per match)

cosmic_timing.required: Sun in Aries (new beginnings) OR Solar Eclipse
cosmic_timing.frequency: Sun in Aries = predictable window, Eclipse = rare power spike
cosmic_timing.check: Game shows 'REBIRTH WINDOW OPEN' with phoenix icon

positioning.formation: Diamond with center point (5 skills total)
positioning.visualization: Skills glow ember-orange, smoke effects rising

resource_cost.note: You must be WILLING TO DIE to execute this Yoga

EXECUTION.step_1: Build at least 3 structures during match
EXECUTION.step_2: Wait until you're losing OR Sun enters Aries/Eclipse
EXECUTION.step_4: PHOENIX YOGA detected - shows current structures turning to ash
EXECUTION.step_5: Confirm sacrifice - ALL your structures die
EXECUTION.step_6: PHOENIX CRUCIBLE ignites - you rise from ashes STRONGER

sacrifice_phase.resource_gain: Gain 3× their total value in resources
sacrifice_phase.vulnerability: You're exposed for 1 turn - enemy can attack
sacrifice_phase.tension: This moment feels SCARY - you look like you're losing

rebirth_phase.resurrection: Structures rebuild automatically in better positions
rebirth_phase.stat_boost: +100% HP, +100% effects on all new structures
rebirth_phase.permanent_growth: +25% stats carry forward to NEXT rebuild
rebirth_phase.invulnerability: Immune to damage for 2 turns during rebirth

evolution.second_rebirth: Structures at 250% power (if you rebuild again)
evolution.infinite_scaling: Each death makes you stronger forever

SCREEN_EFFECT.visual: Everything burns to ash (black screen), then phoenix made of light rises, structures reform with flame trails
SCREEN_EFFECT.audio: Crackling fire → silence → phoenix cry → triumphant rebirth theme
SCREEN_EFFECT.camera: Slow-motion collapse, darkness, then explosive resurrection zoom
SCREEN_EFFECT.duration: 7-second emotional journey from death to glory

prevention: Pressure early before they can setup 3+ structures
Resource denial to prevent 40 KP accumulation
Force them to use Phoenix defensively (weaker)
response: ALL-IN during 1-turn vulnerability window after sacrifice
Don't kill structures - let them keep weak ones instead of rebuilding strong
If they rebirth once, prevent second rebirth or they become unstoppable
COUNTER_PLAY.difficulty: Very hard - Phoenix usually wins after first rebirth

MASTERY_TIPS.beginner: Use Phoenix as comeback mechanic when losing
MASTERY_TIPS.intermediate: Sacrifice STRATEGICALLY - bait enemy into overcommitting
MASTERY_TIPS.advanced: FAKE being weak, let enemy feel confident, then Phoenix
MASTERY_TIPS.expert: Multiple rebirths in one match = exponential scaling
MASTERY_TIPS.psychological: Enemy despair when they think they won, then you rise
MASTERY_TIPS.note: This Yoga teaches comeback mechanics and emotional warfare

YOGA_05_COSMIC_CLOCKWORK.name: Cosmic Clockwork
YOGA_05_COSMIC_CLOCKWORK.flavor_text: Time is your weapon. The cosmos moves in rhythms only you can hear. Strike at the perfect moment, never too early, never too late. You are the conductor of fate.

skills_needed.effect: Structures activate effects on future turns automatically
Reduce OR increase any skill cooldown by 2 turns
Place structure now, it appears 3 turns later at perfect moment

cosmic_timing.required: Any planetary hour that matches your turn count
cosmic_timing.example: Turn 7 = Venus hour, Turn 9 = Mars hour
cosmic_timing.frequency: Happens naturally multiple times per match
cosmic_timing.check: Game shows 'COSMIC HOUR ALIGNMENT' when conditions met
cosmic_timing.why_this_timing: Synchronicity between match time and cosmic time

positioning.visualization: Skills pulse in sequence like a clock ticking

resource_cost.note: Cheap cost, but requires patient timing to maximize

EXECUTION.step_1: Play first 5-7 turns normally, observe cosmic hour changes
EXECUTION.step_2: When your turn count matches planetary hour, setup is ready
EXECUTION.step_3: Arrange 3 skills in line formation (past→present→future visual)
EXECUTION.step_4: CLOCKWORK YOGA detected - UI shows timeline with marked events
EXECUTION.step_5: Cast yoga - all your future actions are now pre-planned
EXECUTION.step_6: COSMIC CLOCKWORK - clock imagery appears showing next 5 turns

immediate.timeline_vision: See next 5 turns with predicted events
immediate.cooldown_control: All your skills come off cooldown simultaneously next turn
immediate.tempo_lock: Enemy actions feel slow compared to your perfect timing

sustained.predictability: You know EXACTLY what will happen and when

tempo_advantage.you_act_first: All your actions resolve before enemy's
tempo_advantage.response_window: You can react to enemy AFTER seeing their move
tempo_advantage.time_compression: Feels like you're playing at 2× speed
tempo_advantage.inevitability: Enemy realizes they're always one step behind

SCREEN_EFFECT.visual: Giant clockface overlays battlefield, gears turning, future positions marked with ghostly structures
SCREEN_EFFECT.audio: Clock ticking + cosmic chimes + gear mechanisms + time acceleration sounds
SCREEN_EFFECT.camera: Time-lapse showing next 5 turns in fast-forward
SCREEN_EFFECT.duration: 5-second sequence showing the timeline you control

prevention: Disrupt their timing - force them to act off-rhythm
Pressure constantly - don't let them wait for perfect moment
Deny cosmic hour alignment by forcing early actions
response: Speed burst - act faster than their predictions
Destroy prophetic structures before they activate

MASTERY_TIPS.beginner: Easy to execute - just match turn to planetary hour
MASTERY_TIPS.intermediate: Plan 5 turns ahead - know your win condition
MASTERY_TIPS.advanced: Use Clockwork to setup OTHER Yogas at perfect moments
MASTERY_TIPS.expert: Combine with Divination engine for PERFECT future control
MASTERY_TIPS.meta_strategy: Force enemy to play reactive while you play proactive
MASTERY_TIPS.note: This Yoga teaches strategic planning and tempo control

detection.real_time_checking: Crucible continuously checks if Yoga conditions are met
detection.skill_highlighting: When you drag Yoga-component skills, they glow with Yoga aura
detection.formation_guide: Ghost images show correct positioning for Yoga patterns

visual_feedback.partial_ready: Skills glow blue if formation correct but timing wrong
visual_feedback.cosmic_window: Planetary symbols pulse when timing is right
visual_feedback.formation_snap: Skills snap into Yoga pattern automatically

achievement_tracking.yoga_library: Shows all 5 Yogas with unlock status
achievement_tracking.mastery_levels: Track executions: Bronze (1), Silver (5), Gold (15), Platinum (50)
achievement_tracking.perfect_execution: Bonus achievement for Yoga in 8th House during Eclipse
achievement_tracking.combo_achievements: Chain 2 Yogas in one match = 'Cosmic Master' title

tutorial_order: 1. Mirror of the Soul - easiest to understand, teaches observation
2. Cosmic Clockwork - teaches timing and planning
3. Bastion of Eternity - defensive safety net for learning
4. Phoenix Crucible - high-risk high-reward, teaches comebacks
5. Chains of Prometheus - expert-level execution, teaches mastery

practice_mode.yoga_trainer: Dedicated mode with AI that helps you practice Yoga timing
practice_mode.cosmic_simulator: Speeds up cosmic cycles so you can practice timing
practice_mode.formation_practice: Drag skills to learn patterns without resource costs

build_around_yogas.yoga_focused_deck: Build entire strategy around executing 1 Yoga perfectly
build_around_yogas.multi_yoga_deck: Include components for 2-3 Yogas, adapt to situation

timing_mind_games.fake_yoga: Partially setup Yoga to bait enemy cooldowns
timing_mind_games.hidden_yoga: Build Yoga components without enemy noticing
timing_mind_games.yoga_trading: Execute your Yoga knowing enemy will respond with theirs
